name: Shishir Naik/ ଶିଶିର ନାୟକ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Shishir Naik’s Odia poem ‘ବ୍ୟର୍ଥ ଦିନ’, published in Kabita Live’s July 2024 issue, gathers a day through brief scenes of disappointment and distress. Fading daylight, someone returning defeated after a twenty-year court case, the tears remembered after a train has left, and an old village vehicle returning through dust form a sequence of interrupted journeys.

Eight two-line stanzas keep these glimpses separate while allowing their sadness to accumulate. The final admission that the speaker’s mother died three days earlier changes the weight of everything that precedes it: public incidents and private grief occupy the same passing day.
